app_info.name: DialectGo
app_info.purpose: A mobile application for trilingual translation (English, Tagalog, and Cebuano) utilizing Machine Learning.

app_features.dictionary: To use the Dictionary, tap the book icon on the bottom navigation bar. Type any word in English, Tagalog, or Cebuano to see its translation and listen to the audio guide.
app_features.games: Yes, we have games! DialectGo currently includes 'Flashcard Match' and 'Word Scramble' to help you practice vocabulary. You can access them from the Dashboard.

user_account.change_name: Go to the Profile tab, tap 'Edit Profile', enter your new name, and click 'Save Changes'.

translation_capabilities.limitations: DialectGo is specialized for conversational phrasing. If you need full paragraph translations, use the main 'Translate' tab on the home screen.
